newsitem.title: USA: Houghten closes sale of Peptide unit.
newsitem.headline: Houghten closes sale of Peptide unit.

text.p: Houghten Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday it has completed the sale of its Multiple Peptide Systems unit to a company to be formed by Houghten founder Richard Houghten.

Houghten Pharmaceuticals said in a statement it will receive $1.5 million in 1997 with three incremental payments, totaling $750,000, to be paid on the third, fourth, and fifth anniversaries of the transaction.
Houghten is a biotechnology company engaged in pharmaceutical drug discovery. Multiple Peptide Systems is a peptide company which sells its products to the research community.
